name: Community — Krea 2 Art & Styles
author: llikswonskcalb / FASCIUM / fwaunstp733 / VaelicoAi / youneedanewname / ccooccoo / SeeSeeLP / nvo76 / easygoing0114 / lonecatone23
description: Four Krea 2 checkpoints that do not look like Krea 2. Stock Krea 2 Turbo already handles anime, painting and fantasy prompts well, so a style card only earns its 13 GB if it gives a different picture; of six we tested side by side, these four did. Equinox: crisp, idealised semi-real characters with their own compositions. Fascium KREA ART: 99 painterly artist styles, turns everything into paint. Fwaun Tune: flat-colour, lineless semi-chibi characters. Wulver: anthro and kemono characters that stay animals. Since 1.1.0 the pack also carries four anime checkpoints the community asked for: Krea2-Anime (clean, flat anime with thin lines) and CocoaMix (soft, cute faces) look clearly different; See-Krea2 and Krea 2 Full stay close to stock Krea 2 and are here because users asked for them. Since 1.2.0, Krea-2-Nippon_clear, also close to stock and also by request: cleaner, brighter cel-anime faces and deeper blues on Japanese subjects, non-commercial use only, 15.9 GB. Since 1.3.0, Animosity v2.0, also by request and clearly different: dark, ornate, heavily coloured semi-real anime, with a fix for same-looking faces. All render at native ~2 MP with an Upscale slider (1.1-2x) that adds a gated 4-step detail-refine pass, and share the Qwen3VL 4B encoder and Qwen-Image VAE with the other Krea 2 packs, so each card costs only its 13-14 GB checkpoint. For photography use the Krea 2 or Krea 2 Finetunes packs.

presets.name: Equinox Krea 2 (Semi-Realistic)
presets.tagline: Crisp, idealised semi-real characters and illustration
presets.description:
Text to image with crisp, idealised semi-real characters: sharp eyes, clean shading and compositions of its own instead of stock Krea 2's. It works best on anime, fantasy and illustration prompts, and it was the most distinct of the six Krea 2 checkpoints we compared. This is the first Krea 2 release of the Equinox model, and the author calls it experimental.

It restyles photo prompts too (younger, prettier, glossier), so use a Krea 2 realism card for candid photography.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass. About 16 seconds a picture at 1024x1536 on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): credit required, no derivatives or merges, commercial use of images not granted.

presets.name: Fascium KREA ART (Painterly)
presets.tagline: Paints everything: oil, engraving and poster styles by name
presets.description:
Text to image that paints everything: a merge of 99 artist styles covering old-master oil, Baroque, Impressionist, Art Nouveau, engraving, poster lithography and anime production art. It is painterly by design. In our test every prompt turned into paint, and even an anime schoolgirl came out as a painted illustration rather than cel anime.

Call a style by name: 'in the manner of Rembrandt', 'in the style of Gustav Klimt', 'in the manner of Alphonse Mucha', 'Piranesi style', 'in the style of J.M.W. Turner'.

SFW by design. For photographs use a Krea 2 realism card.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass. About 21 seconds a picture at 1024x1536 on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): commercial use, merges and derivatives allowed.

presets.name: Fwaun Tune Krea 2 (Semi-Chibi)
presets.tagline: Flat colour, no line art, big-headed characters
presets.description:
Text to image in one look: flat colour, no outlines, and softly deformed, big-headed characters. The style is strong. In our test it redrew every prompt this way, including a photo prompt and a Rembrandt oil painting.

The card adds the trigger 'semi-chibi style.' in front of your prompt for you. The author's other triggers also work when you type them: 'monochrome', and 'photorealistic background' for a flat character over a photo-like scene.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass. About 18 seconds a picture at 1024x1536 on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): commercial use of images allowed, derivatives allowed.

presets.name: Wulver Krea 2 (Anthro)
presets.tagline: Anthro and kemono characters that stay animals
presets.description:
Text to image for anthro, furry and kemono characters that stay animals. In our test stock Krea 2 drew a small anime cat-wolf, while this drew a real wolf-headed character with a muzzle, fur and paws every time. It is a full fine-tune of Krea 2, not a merge.

Prompt in prose (60-120 words, and describe the background) or in booru/e621 tags. The card puts the rating tag 'sfw,' in front of your prompt, as the model expects.

It also knows 1,113 artist tokens (@name, typed first; the list is on the model's Hugging Face page). There are two catches, and we saw them on every render: a token can write the artist's name on the picture as a signature, and the character can lose clothing you asked for. Even without a token, a faint signature scribble sometimes appears in a corner. The author also reports a smeared top or bottom edge on some pictures.

There is no CFG slider because higher CFG burns the picture.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass.

Licence: Krea 2 Community License (see the Hugging Face repo). The Civitai page asks for credit.

presets.name: Krea2-Anime v2.0 (fp8)
presets.tagline: Clean, bright anime with thin linework; mature-trained
presets.description:
Text to image for clean, bright anime with thin lines, even light and its own poses. In our test it drew the cleanest, flattest anime of the Krea 2 cards. It is Krea 2 Turbo trained further on a million-picture mature anime set, about a quarter of the planned training by the author's account.

It wants long, detailed prompts: describe the setting, the action, the character and the style in sentences, then add tags. Short prompts look like any anime model.

Artist tags barely work, and the author advises against 4-step LoRAs.

Renders at about 2 MP. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass. About 28 seconds a picture at 2 MP on a 12 GB card.

Licence (Civitai): commercial use, merges and derivatives allowed.

presets.name: Ray Krea2 x Mid Aesthetic
presets.description:
Moody, romantic pictures with a Midjourney and Niji feel: rich, dark colour, cinematic framing and a touch of gothic melancholy. It works across portraits, landscapes, sci-fi and anime, and keeps the same polished look on all of them.

Ray3780 built it on Krea 2 Turbo from a blend of @OnlyLemon's LoRAs, which were trained on her own artwork. In our test it often framed people closer than the prompt asked and sometimes made them younger and more glamorous (a woman in her thirties came out about twenty), so describe age and framing clearly if they matter. Anime prompts come out as painted, semi-real illustration.

Write plain sentences. Krea 2 ignores negative prompts at CFG 1.

This card uses the author's ER SDE at 12 steps and CFG 1, about 42 seconds a picture at 2 MP on a 12 GB card. The author suggests 8 to 12 steps. The Upscale slider (1.1-2x) adds a detail-refine pass.

requirements.notes: Krea 2 DiT (diffusion_models) + Qwen3VL 4B fp8 encoder + Qwen-Image VAE, shared with the other Krea 2 cards. CFG 1, negative zeroed. Upscale >1 adds the 4-step denoise-0.1 refine pass gated off at Upscale 1, as on the other Krea 2 cards. Krea 2 Turbo fine-tune, INT8 ConvRot (diffusion_models, 12.82 GB, sha256 554b9d48b93c7d4db698ba7f35cee3dc79e34b521557cbfea1f03ddbe84bd999, Civitai model 3009760 / version 3415465 'turbo v1 INT8ConvRot' / fileId 3308391, by Ray3780, published 2026-10-19; the only file). Author: er_sde / simple, 8-12 steps, CFG 1; the author's sample PNGs read 10-12 steps er_sde simple with a Wan 2.1 VAE (the same architecture as the Qwen-Image VAE the card uses) and abliterated Qwen3-VL encoders. Bake: on the 'woman in her thirties' photo prompt both seeds came out about twenty and glamorous; tighter framing than base Turbo on photo and gothic prompts. Baked 2026-11-06 on a 4070 Ti 12 GB (SimpliGen engine, ComfyUI 0.44.0, direct submission) at 1024x1536 on 5 prompts x 2 seeds against Krea 2 Turbo, duplicate control pixel-identical (F:\Claude-Work\checkpoint-request-20261106). Engine-direct median 24.8 s. Verified in the app 2026-11-06 (engine v0.44.0): photo on 2 seeds at 3:4 (1216x1632), a lettered poster at 1:1 (spelled right), anime at 16:9, a portrait at 2:3 (a woman in her fifties kept her age) and Upscale 1.5 at 1:1, all clean; settings read back from engine history; median 42.4 s per picture through the app, 71.6 s at Upscale 1.5.
